# Sensemaking Skills

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT)
[![Python 3.11+](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.11+-blue.svg)](https://www.python.org/downloads/)

An ontology-grounded repository understanding and prospective reasoning system for software-engineering agents. It helps an agent understand what a repository is, explore and compare what it could become, select or recommend a warranted direction, and preserve that reasoning as durable, source-linked knowledge, without replacing the agent's semantic judgment. Implementation is an optional downstream use that needs its own authority. Start with one Skill: [`using-sensemaking`](skills/using-sensemaking/SKILL.md). See [ADR 0034](docs/adr/0034-ontology-first-adaptive-sensemaking.md).

**Owner-selected long-term direction (October 2026):** build a **persistent, typed, queryable semantic memory of software products**—their intent, capabilities, constraints, architecture, decisions, verification and engineering history—operated and improved through specialized Skills over many development episodes.
